decision: PASS for the bounded saved-pixel display scope: no visible prose, equation-layout, composition, figure-label, or framing defect requiring revision was observed.
limitations: Only the six listed saved screenshots were visually opened, exactly once each in one batch. No crops, reopens, new captures, browser sessions, or source/figure-asset reopens were performed.
The saved evidence is isolated headless offline HTML, not a headed browser, production page, interactive workflow, or full accessibility acceptance.

The mobile whole-page image was automatically reduced from 390x7983 to 293x6000 for inspection. Its observations concern composition and visible layout, not pixel-level certification of every character.

Small fraction components, exponents, subscripts, vector accents, and other fine glyphs are not certified beyond their observed resolution. Equation structure and spacing were inspected without replaying semantic science approval.

Source fidelity, science, English wording, and original figure approvals were treated as valid and unchanged per the user's scope; they were not re-reviewed. Counts and actual media widths are metadata, not independently recounted source content.
No database access, regeneration, content edits, commits, pushes, or other agents were used. Only the designated review.json was written; other worktree edits were preserved.
